metadata.title: Anthropic Claude Discovers ART Enzyme System
metadata.production_phase: Phase 11 - Visual Storyboarding & Technical Shot Planning

bacteriophage_architecture.type: Jumbo Phage (Icosahedral Capsid with contractile tail)
bacteriophage_architecture.capsid_geometry: Faceted icosahedron in matte titanium-charcoal with glowing cyan genomic core
bacteriophage_architecture.tail_assembly: Central sheath with flexible baseplate and tail fibers gripping bacterial cell wall
bacteriophage_architecture.scale_presentation: Sub-micron molecular level with realistic depth of field

art_enzyme_tripartite_system.component_1_rt: Reverse Transcriptase enzyme rendered as an articulated electric-cyan globular protein catalytic domain
art_enzyme_tripartite_system.component_2_partner: Partner protein rendered in deep violet adjacent to RT catalytic groove
art_enzyme_tripartite_system.component_3_array: Linear DNA strand featuring equidistant mint-green rectangular tandem repeat blocks separated by darker spacer sequences

wet_lab_validation_elements.setting: San Francisco wet laboratory biological assay
wet_lab_validation_elements.visual_motif: Electrophoretic polyacrylamide gel visualization showing fluorescent band illumination of transcribed short RNA
wet_lab_validation_elements.instrumentation: Automated precision micropipette and fluorescent imaging sensor interface

scientific_boundary_watermark.placement: Prominent upper safe zone callout card on Shot 05

shots.visual_goal: Deliver maximum first-2-second retention hook: transition from abstract computational code into an ultra-sharp 3D bacteriophage virus landing on a bacterial membrane with luminous cyan protein traces.
shots.voiceover_segment: AI didn't just write code—it just discovered new biology.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up starting on glowing code tokens that dissolve into molecular protein space, rapidly dollying out to reveal a faceted icosahedral bacteriophage landing on a bacterial surface at 0.8s.
shots.lighting: Deep cosmic blackness (#070A0F), sharp rim lighting with electric cyan (#4DEBFF) and violet (#9B7CFF) emissive glows highlighting the virus capsid and tail fibers.
shots.diagram_elements: Kinetic typography card: 'AI DISCOVERS NEW BIOLOGY' centered at Y:260; callout label at 1.5s: 'BACTERIOPHAGE VIRUS (NATURAL HOST)'.
shots.animation: Code matrix rapidly reassembles into molecular folding animation; viral tail fibers contract against the cell wall, illuminating internal nucleic acid pathways.
shots.sfx: Deep sub-bass impact whoosh at 0.0s transitioning into high-frequency digital-to-biological chime at 1.2s.
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic molecular biology animation. Starts on floating cyan computer code tokens in dark space that instantly dissolve and fold into a photorealistic 3D bacteriophage virus. The virus has a charcoal-titanium geometric icosahedral head and delicate landing legs that anchor onto a glowing organic bacterial membrane. Luminous electric cyan (#4DEBFF) bioluminescent pathways travel down the viral sheath. High contrast, photorealistic scientific rendering, volumetric lighting, deep dark background (#070A0F). Pacing: rapid, arresting motion in the first 2 seconds. No cartoon textures, no messy noise, clean modern scientific visualization.
shots.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 high-precision scientific render of a bacteriophage virus landing on a bacterial surface, dark charcoal canvas, electric cyan and violet bioluminescent protein highlights, photorealistic, 8k octane render.
shots.negative_prompt: cartoon, 2d doodle, messy liquid, dirty lab bench, fake human face, futuristic robot, generic chatbot interface, blurry.

asset_plan.prompt: Photorealistic 3D bacteriophage virus landing on cell wall with cyan fluorescent protein traces on dark technical canvas
asset_plan.attribution: Original procedural visual generated for AI News Factory

shots.visual_goal: Convey the colossal scale and computational throughput of the search: parallel network diagram showing 1,000 Claude agents screening 1.9 billion protein clusters.
shots.voiceover_segment: Anthropic deployed about one thousand Claude agents to scan nearly two billion protein clusters.
shots.camera: Wide isometric network view slowly dollying forward into a multi-tiered filtering matrix of protein cluster nodes.
shots.lighting: Dark navy grid (#0E131F) with pulse lines in electric cyan (#4DEBFF) and cluster nodes glowing in amber-gold (#FFB84D) and violet (#9B7CFF).
shots.diagram_elements: Header card: '1,000 AGENTS • 1.9B CLUSTERS'; central metric display: '1.9 BILLION PROTEIN CLUSTERS FILTERED'; lower telemetry badge: '~1,000 AGENT SESSIONS | ~200,000 CANDIDATE RTs'.
shots.animation: High-velocity data streams pulse across parallel agent nodes, rapidly funneling a vast matrix of 1.9 billion protein dots down into a concentrated glowing candidate node.
shots.sfx: High-speed data computation hum, subtle rhythmic scanning pulses (3.5s, 5.0s, 6.5s).
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 technical computational diagram. A dark futuristic data canvas displays a massive multi-layered neural search grid. Thousands of parallel cyan agent rays converge on an immense matrix of glowing microscopic protein cluster nodes labeled 1.9 BILLION. Fast-paced animated filtering pipelines funnel millions of data points into a single refined golden molecular node. Minimalist UI overlays, clean sans-serif telemetry numbers, dark charcoal background (#070A0F), crisp vector lines. Smooth forward push camera.
shots.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 scientific system flowchart showing 1,000 autonomous AI agents screening 1.9 billion protein clusters, dark charcoal background, electric cyan and gold accent nodes, clean technical infographics.
shots.negative_prompt: messy clutter, chaotic wires, low resolution, unreadable fonts, cheesy stock charts.

asset_plan.prompt: Technical diagram showing 1,000 AI agents filtering 1.9 billion protein clusters into refined candidate biological systems
asset_plan.attribution: Original scientific vector diagram designed for AI News Factory

shots.visual_goal: Reveal the core discovery (ART architecture): high-precision molecular blueprint showing the Reverse Transcriptase enzyme, the partner gene, and the CRISPR-like repeating tandem DNA array.
shots.voiceover_segment: In just about twenty-one hours, Claude discovered ART: a novel enzyme system hidden inside viruses with repeating arrays that resemble CRISPR.
shots.camera: Smooth horizontal tracking pan from the Reverse Transcriptase protein body across to the repeating DNA array, tilting slightly to highlight repeating spacer geometry.
shots.lighting: Targeted volumetric studio lighting. Cyan (#4DEBFF) for Reverse Transcriptase, violet (#9B7CFF) for partner gene, mint green (#54E39A) for the tandem repeat DNA blocks.
shots.diagram_elements: Header card: 'ART • CRISPR-LIKE REPEATS'; runtime badge at 9.0s: 'SEARCH TIME: ~21.5 HOURS'; callout labels: 'REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE (RNA -> DNA)', 'PARTNER GENE', and 'TANDEM REPEAT ARRAY (CRISPR-LIKE)'.
shots.animation: The three components assemble into locked registration: the RT enzyme locks beside the partner protein, while a glowing DNA double helix extends to the right with evenly spaced mint-green repeat cassettes illuminating sequentially.
shots.sfx: Precision mechanical snap sound as components align (9.5s), followed by a rising harmonic crystalline hum across the repeating arrays (12.0s).
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 3D molecular biology schematic. A glowing genetic system named ART is displayed against a deep black canvas. On the left, an articulated electric-cyan globular enzyme labeled REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE sits adjacent to a violet PARTNER GENE. Extending to the right, a DNA double helix displays an unannotated array of evenly spaced, glowing mint-green rectangular blocks labeled CRISPR-LIKE TANDEM REPEATS. Smooth lateral pan camera highlighting the rhythmic repeating architecture. High technical clarity, photorealistic biological textures, crisp sans-serif annotations.
shots.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 molecular biology schematic of ART system: Reverse Transcriptase in cyan, partner gene in violet, and repeating CRISPR-like DNA spacer arrays in mint green, dark technical aesthetic, photorealistic 8k render.
shots.negative_prompt: cartoon DNA, distorted text, fake human cells, blurry bands, neon oversaturation.

asset_plan.prompt: Molecular diagram of Array-associated Reverse Transcriptase (ART) system showing RT enzyme, partner gene, and CRISPR-like repeating arrays
asset_plan.attribution: Original biological system diagram designed for AI News Factory

shots.visual_goal: Present empirical experimental validation: human biologists in Anthropic's San Francisco wet lab verifying that the repeat arrays transcribe into discrete short RNA molecules.
shots.voiceover_segment: Human scientists verified it in their San Francisco wet lab, confirming the array produces short RNA molecules.
shots.camera: Direct orthographic technical card view with subtle slow push-in focusing on the fluorescent gel electrophoresis band readout.
shots.lighting: Controlled laboratory UV transillumination aesthetic: deep charcoal framing with sharp fluorescent amber-gold (#FFB84D) RNA bands and mint-green verification checkmark (#54E39A).
shots.diagram_elements: Header card: 'WET-LAB VERIFIED • SHORT RNA'; location stamp: 'ANTHROPIC BIOLOGY LAB • SAN FRANCISCO, CA'; technical assay readout: 'POLYACRYLAMIDE GEL ASSAY: DISCRETE SHORT RNA MOLECULES CONFIRMED'; disclosure: 'ORIGINAL SCIENTIFIC SIMULATION — NOT ORIGINAL EXPERIMENTAL DATA'.
shots.animation: Fluorescent RNA bands illuminate sequentially within the gel lanes, accompanied by a clean green verification checkmark and micro-pulse border confirmation.
shots.sfx: Subtle tactile laboratory confirmation chime (16.0s), gentle electronic UV transilluminator hum.
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 scientific evidence card. Dark technical lab aesthetic showing conceptual procedural reconstruction of wet-lab validation. An illuminated polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis assay displays sharp, fluorescent golden bands representing mature short RNA transcripts. Technical badges in clean modern typography read: 'ANTHROPIC BIOLOGY LAB • SAN FRANCISCO' and 'IN-VITRO TRANSCRIPTION VERIFIED'. A discreet technical disclosure watermark reads: 'ORIGINAL SCIENTIFIC SIMULATION — NOT ORIGINAL EXPERIMENTAL DATA'. A verified badge checkmark illuminates in mint green. Crisp, authoritative, highly scientific.
shots.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 scientific technical vector diagram reconstructing gel electrophoresis RNA band assay from wet-lab verification, dark charcoal background, fluorescent golden RNA bands, mint green verified badge, modern typography, disclosure 'ORIGINAL SCIENTIFIC SIMULATION'.
shots.negative_prompt: fake scientist posing with colored beaker, cheesy stock medical photo, distorted fonts, cartoon pills, raw photographic data forgery.

shots.visual_goal: Enforce strict scientific boundary: clearly communicate that ART is fundamental biological architecture, NOT a human gene therapy or clinical editing tool.
shots.voiceover_segment: This is not a gene therapy or a human gene-editing tool. It's a new biological architecture.
shots.camera: Slow cinematic pull-back from a macro DNA strand to an expansive conceptual geometric lattice representing unexplored biological space.
shots.lighting: High contrast between alert coral-red (#FF5C70) defining the strict negative boundary and majestic electric cyan (#4DEBFF) / violet (#9B7CFF) representing foundational discovery.
shots.diagram_elements: Header card: 'NOT GENE THERAPY • NEW BIOLOGY'; prominent safe-zone boundary badge: 'FUNDAMENTAL BIOLOGY • NO GENE EDITING'; subtext: 'FUNDAMENTAL BIOLOGICAL DISCOVERY'.
shots.animation: Red boundary lockup frames the upper card with a definitive shield icon; the underlying biological DNA lattice blooms outward into an interconnected web of discovered enzyme structures.
shots.sfx: Low authoritative bass tone establishing gravity (21.5s), resolving into an expansive, forward-looking synth riser (24.0s).
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 scientific concept visualization. Against a deep space-black canvas, an elegant cyan DNA double helix expands into an expansive crystalline biological lattice. A prominent, elegant technical warning badge in clean coral-red (#FF5C70) typography clearly reads: 'FUNDAMENTAL BIOLOGY • NO GENE EDITING'. Below, typography highlights 'FUNDAMENTAL BIOLOGICAL DISCOVERY'. Restrained, majestic, strictly scientific. Smooth pull-back camera.
shots.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 technical scientific graphic showing expanding molecular DNA lattice with prominent warning badge 'FUNDAMENTAL BIOLOGY • NO GENE EDITING', dark technical canvas, cyan and coral red accents.
shots.negative_prompt: hospital bed, syringe, medical injection, sick human patient, cartoon doctor, fantasy mutant, sensationalist text.

shots.diagram_elements: AI NEWS FACTORY master brand lockup, verified badge checkmark (#54E39A), subtext: 'IF YOU FOUND THIS USEFUL • FOLLOW AI NEWS FACTORY', pill button: 'LIKE • SHARE • SUBSCRIBE'.
shots.animation: Brand title 'AI NEWS FACTORY' reveals with crisp kerning expansion; kinetic subtitle and CTA button snap into lockup with micro-scale bounce.
shots.sfx: Channel branded audio logo chime + soft tactile confirmation click (27.0s).
shots.veo_prompt: Vertical 9:16 brand lockup. Dark technical canvas (#070A0F) with geometric accent lines in restrained electric cyan (#4DEBFF) and violet (#9B7CFF). Center typography displays AI NEWS FACTORY with modern sans-serif letterforms and verified checkmark emblem in mint green.
